name: Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5
desc:
Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5 is a tactical openworld shooter with vast maps and thrilling gameplay. Engage in team-based combat throughout Ronograd Island or rescue survivors in the exciting new ZOMBIES gamemode. Go head to head in PvP or even build out your own Headquarters to boost your income offline.

• Customize your operator with over 1000+ unique outfit combinations.
• Build your dream gun with 70+ choices and over 100 attachments. 
• Purchase and own 20+ vehicles and helicopters from modern militaries. 
• Multiple engaging gamemodes with many hours of fun ahead.
• Make your own custom scenarios and maps with the Sandbox Mode. [Realtime Game Editor]

PC, Console, and Mobile are supported. 
Headphones recommended for best audio experience. All music is non-copyright and streamer safe.

Based on PlatinumFive's original Military RP games.

scripts.title: clear nvg
scripts.features: it should remove the nvg overlay shape
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

for _, guiElement in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
    if guiElement:IsA("ScreenGui") and guiElement.Name == "NVGInterface" then
        guiElement:Destroy()
    end
end

scripts.title: VERY BASIC  ESP
scripts.features: Basic ass ESP, open sourced if you want to try get an aimbot working.
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local function highlightMaleModels()
    for _, object in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if object:IsA("Model") and object.Name == "Male" then
            if not object:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight") then
                local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                highlight.Adornee = object
                highlight.Parent = object
                highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200) 
                highlight.FillTransparency = 0.75
            end
        end
    end
end

while true do
    highlightMaleModels()
    wait(5)
end
